title: fix(service-datasource): a plugin-driver datasource connected or reconnected through the connection service keeps the engine's floor
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiVy7F2atKWpo5rp3YPrqddh)_

**Fable review owed.** This PR was finished on Opus while the Fable quota was out (maintainer order: finish on Opus, then wait for the contract review). It touches `packages/spec/src/**`, so it does not land until an independent full Fable review and a same-shape `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record PASS on its current head.

Card #27666 (epic #27261), from the post-landing contract review of PR #27403 (6502877381, ③).

## What changes

- `EngineDatasourceDef` (`@objectstack/spec/contracts`) gains an optional `driver`, the datasource's driver id.
- `DatasourceConnectionService.connect` registers the def with `record.driver`. `reconnect`'s keep-old-pool restore registers the old record's driver id (`previous.driver`). Before this, a plugin-driver datasource built through the connection service was never held behind the #27277 floor, and a reconnect dropped the floor because `unregisterDriver` deletes the stored def.
- The engine comment on `registerDatasourceDef` now says the stored id is a keep, not a source.
- Riders from the same review (④, comment-only): the `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_EXCEEDED` ledger row says why it is deliberately not the standard `MAX_RECORDS_EXCEEDED`, and the "ADR-0015 Tier A" citations in objectql name the epic ruling instead.

## Evidence (local, at `df7e3c66`)

- `packages/spec` `src/contracts/data-engine.test.ts`: 36/36.
- `packages/objectql` `src/external-driver-floor.test.ts`: 54/54, including the unregister-then-connect sequences.
- `packages/services/service-datasource`: connection-service and update-rebuild suites, 114/114.
- `tsc --noEmit` clean for spec, objectql and service-datasource.
- spec `check:api-surface`, `check:export-origins`, `check:docs`, `check:generated` and `check:error-code-provenance` all exit 0.

Implementation: the #27666 card thread's commit (picked onto this branch after the thread stalled on the quota) plus the epic PM's changeset declaration.
